<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula: DBE = (2C + 2 + N – H – X) / 2. For C₁₆H₂₇O₃, C = 16, H = 27, N = 0, X = 0. DBE = (2·16 + 2 – 27) / 2 = (32 + 2 – 27) / 2 = 7 / 2 = 3.5. Since DBE must be reported as an integer, we take the integer part, giving 3.</thought>
<final_answer>3</final_answer>
